subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep the shipped systemd exit-78 supervised-lock behavior, adopt this PR's authenticated probe plus exit-0 behavior, or close/split this branch in favor of a narrow current-main follow-up?
rationale: The PR changes service-manager exit semantics and gateway auth probing in an area current main has already solved differently, so automation cannot choose the permanent upgrade contract safely.

options.title: Keep exit 78
options.body: Treat current main's shipped systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as canonical and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrow follow-up.

options.title: Adopt probe semantics
options.body: Approve the probe-based direction only after a rebase and real proof across shared-secret, trusted-proxy, TLS, and foreign-listener cases.

options.title: Split useful coverage
options.body: Preserve only tests or docs that improve current-main behavior while dropping this branch's exit-code and trusted-proxy probe changes.

recommendation.title: Keep exit 78
recommendation.body: Treat current main's shipped systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as canonical and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrow follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current shipped systemd EADDRINUSE fix and is the clearest history owner for the exit-code decision.
